pomata.name: Hair Pomade
pomata.desc: The Darta pomade to shape and define the cut. Work it in with your hands and comb through.
use: Warm it between your palms and work it through the hair.

olio.name: Beard Oil
olio.desc: A nourishing beard serum: a few pumps to soften the beard and give it a neat finish.
use: Press the pump 2-3 times into your palm.
Warm it up and spread from root to tip.

sale.name: Eco Spray
sale.tag: Spray with aloe vera and green tea
sale.short: Aloe vera and green tea, 300 ml.
sale.desc: The Darta spray with aloe vera and green tea, in a 300 ml can.
use: Comb or style as you like.

curlman.name: Curl Man
curlman.desc: The Darta fluid for curly hair: it defines the curls and keeps them soft.
use: Work it from the lengths to the ends.
Let it air dry or use a diffuser.

curlcontrol.name: Curl Control
curlcontrol.desc: The Darta product for curly hair with aloe vera and coconut oil, in a pump bottle.
use: Press the pump once or twice into your palm.

clay.name: Hair Powder Clay
clay.short: Volume and texture, without the weight.
clay.desc: The clay powder Thomas uses to add volume at the root and texture all over, with a natural matte finish. It goes on dry, restyles whenever you like and washes out with normal shampoo.
use: Shake a little powder onto dry roots.
Work it in with your fingers for volume.
